title: [Main]-Project Ledger Entry does not get the modified amount from Purchase Order Statistics if the Purchase line is of type G/L Account in the Spanish version.
summary: Fixed a bug where project ledger entries did not reflect modified invoice discounts on G/L Account lines in purchase orders, even though G/L entries were correct.
key_points: Project ledger entries now use the invoiced discount when partial invoices are posted with a changed invoice discount on G/L Account lines
New procedures in Purch.-Post calculate the per-unit discount gap and apply it to the unit cost of the line copy used for project posting
The adjustment accounts for Indirect Cost %, Prices Including VAT and currency
Item lines were not affected by the bug
Purch.-Post changed in W1, NA, BE, CH, ES, FI, GB, IT, RU and APAC layers; Job Transfer Line also updated in W1, NA, BE and IT
